Draft report on policy recommendations to strengthen competitiveness (PISA)
se: Meeting on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 13.30 hrs, Committee Meeting Room CA 328, floor 3, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider the draft study report on policy recommendations to strengthen competitiveness (PISA), with the working group and related agencies invited to take part, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.

Progress on policy proposals to expand and upgrade dual vocational education
se: The meeting considered the progress of the working group preparing policy recommendations on expanding and upgrading dual vocational education. The working group and related agencies were invited to take part: the Ministry of Labour and the Eastern Economic Corridor Office (EEC), according to the press release the Senate published.
